sql: select 'resting' k, count(*)::text v from live_orders where status='resting' union all select 'last_bot_run', max(started_at)::text from bot_runs union all select 'last_incentive_snap', max(at)::text from incentive_market_snapshots union all select 'last_shadow_quote', max(placed_at)::text from incentive_shadow_quotes union all select 'last_mmsell_tick', max(id)::text from mmsell_position_ticks union all select 'drained', count(*)::text from live_orders where cancel_reason='book_stood_down' and updated_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
